title: repository-evolution-analysis
summary: Analyze a repository's commit history to build a capability-evolution model: what the system can do, how it got there, and what patterns allow it to iterate quickly. Use to produce history-derived knowledge for agent skill conditioning, and to design temporal-split benchmarks for skill evaluation.
